description: This file defines the AdminSettings class, representing administrative configuration data with fields for tenant ID, key, and JSON value, including constructors, getters, setters, and overrides for hashCode, equals, and toString.

classes.name: AdminSettings
classes.description: Represents administrative settings with tenant ID, key, and JSON value, extending BaseData and implementing HasTenantId.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the auto-generated UUID of the settings.

methods.name: getCreatedTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of creation in milliseconds.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Returns the tenant ID associated with the settings.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key of the settings (e.g., 'mail').

methods.name: setKey
methods.description: Sets the key of the settings.

methods.name: getJsonValue
methods.description: Returns the JSON value of the settings.

methods.name: setJsonValue
methods.description: Sets the JSON value of the settings.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on key and jsonValue.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another AdminSettings object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the AdminSettings object.
